title: VideoLAN libaacs 0.7.0 through 0.12.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in aacs_resolve_path() that…
description: VideoLAN libaacs versions 0.7.0 through 0.12.0 have a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the aacs_resolve_path() function. This flaw allows local attackers to corrupt stack memory by using crafted symbolic links in disc paths. Exploitation involves planting a symlink with an excessively long target in extracted archives, removable media, or shared directories, causing a strcat() operation to overflow a 1024-byte buffer. This can crash the player or potentially lead to code execution.
